title: Excursion Credit, Port Charges and Visa Assistance on Vacation Package Products
content:
Against each of the Vacation Package Products the operator publishes an excursion or resort credit granted per traveller at the start of the journey, the calendar days from departure within which that credit must be spent, the discount on excursions booked in advance, the port charges and government taxes charged per traveller on a sailing, and the charge for the operator's visa assistance service per traveller.

| Product | Excursion or resort credit per traveller | Credit validity from departure | Advance excursion discount | Port charges per traveller | Visa assistance per traveller |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | 0.00 USD | 0 calendar days | 0 per cent | 0.00 USD | 85.00 USD |
| Flex Bundle Package | 0.00 USD | 0 calendar days | 5 per cent | 0.00 USD | 75.00 USD |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | 75.00 USD | 7 calendar days | 10 per cent | 0.00 USD | 65.00 USD |
| Escorted Tour Package | 100.00 USD | 10 calendar days | 10 per cent | 0.00 USD | 55.00 USD |
| Ocean Cruise Package | 125.00 USD | 12 calendar days | 15 per cent | 189.00 USD | 65.00 USD |
| Luxury Collection Package | 350.00 USD | 14 calendar days | 20 per cent | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |

*Footnote to the credit columns.* A credit figure of nil carries a validity term of nil against the same product, the two entries standing together: the Value Bundle Package and the Flex Bundle Package publish no excursion or resort credit and therefore no term within which one might be spent. Where a credit is published, its validity term is counted in calendar days from departure, running from 7 calendar days on the All-Inclusive Resort Package to 14 calendar days on the Luxury Collection Package.

*Footnote to the port charges column.* Port charges and government taxes are a charge on a sailing, and the Ocean Cruise Package is the only one of the six Vacation Package Products publishing a figure above nil, at 189.00 USD per traveller.

*Footnote to the visa assistance column.* The visa assistance charge falls as the products rise, from 85.00 USD on the Value Bundle Package to nil on the Luxury Collection Package, where the service carries no charge at all. The Ocean Cruise Package and the All-Inclusive Resort Package publish the same figure of 65.00 USD.
